physical_subject: Why do equal decibel steps represent equal power ratios?
relationship: For positive power ratios, levels in decibels equal ten times the base-ten logarithm; cascaded multiplicative power gains add in decibels and negative relative levels still represent positive power.
operation: Carry the same four powers from a linear chart into exponent levels, then compose two actual gain stages and compare a below-reference power.
closest_prior: Logarithmic spiral, piano tuning, Rule of72 and inverse-square light
substantive_difference: Logarithmic measurement and composition of power ratios; not spiral shape, tuning ratios, exponential doubling-time estimation or radiative spreading.
